assign.outcome: **Round 4 Q4 answered: the program audited its own inputs.** Seeded stratified sample of 60 entries (15/topic, mulberry32 seed 42) across all four research logs -- every url fetched and checked. Rates: 40% VERIFIED, 30% EXISTS-BUT-WEAK, 13.3% WRONG, 16.7% UNREACHABLE (mostly bot-blocked .mil/.gov/paywalls). Of 8 WRONG entries, a follow-up WebSearch showed 6 are true facts pinned to a wrong/too-generic url; only 2 (a Saqqara Bird aerodynamic-test claim, a Dogon-Sirius mundane-channel theory) are genuinely unverifiable content. Verdict: sourcing mostly held -- outright invention is closer to 3% than the >60% AI-search base rate the question was testing against. 4 established findings appended to theories/log.jsonl; a new The audit section added to the synthesis page.
